records.absent_capability: game.mining remains false by default. Accepted request intent does not imply an available or active engine adapter.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*request)(sco_plugin* self, uint32_t enabled);`
enabled is exactly 0 or 1. Accept or remove owner-scoped intent; repeated requests are idempotent. OK accepts intent even when engine/admission/hook is unavailable; read state to distinguish active. Disable also removes intent after a fault latch.
records.callback_context: No plugin callback; worker invokes host-owned process-retained backend only.
records.cleanup: Disable/unload removes only that owner intent. Stop clears all intent and withdraws the service; detour, trampoline and callbacks remain process-retained in pass-through mode. Fault latch requires restart.

records.ownership: Up to 64 live owners retain independent intent; worker sees only aggregate count. Caller owns copied output; no native pointer or allocation transfer.
records.purpose: enabled is exactly 0 or 1. Accept or remove owner-scoped intent; repeated requests are idempotent. OK accepts intent even when engine/admission/hook is unavailable; read state to distinguish active. Disable also removes intent after a fault latch.
records.reentrancy: Public calls during backend admission/install are refused with UNAVAILABLE.
records.results: OK accepted intent, not engine acceptance; BAD_ARG invalid/released self or enabled; WRONG_THREAD; UNAVAILABLE stopped/runtime-stopping or reentrant call; FAILED full 64-owner registry.
records.thread_affinity: Game thread only; WRONG_THREAD before owner/state access. Worker promotion never calls plugins.
